door: ^Kemal's coat still hangs beside the door. Leyla has three days of leave before she returns to Rotterdam. The house will remain after she goes.

^Hacer arrives with soup. "I think of the Prophet asking people to cook for Ja'far's family. Let us feed you. You have enough to carry." Burak has a folded account in his pocket. On the table are a notebook and an envelope addressed to Şükrü.

^Hacer says, "I follow the view that we can sit here for three days, if it doesn't burden you." Şükrü calls from his home across the city. He hears Hacer on the speaker. "I follow the view that these gatherings renew grief. I would close the door."
^Keep a clear account and answer the promised visit before the third evening. Protect what is private. You can finish without telling anyone about your marriage.
^Thank her and keep the door yourself.
claim: ^Burak brings two repair bills. Kemal wrote "advance returned" across both. Burak paid for an earlier repair; Şükrü paid for the boiler. The crossed-out line does not say who got their money back.
^ has the receipt. "We need the name on it," Burak says.

^Şükrü says, "I believe the saying that a believer's soul remains suspended by a debt until it is paid. That frightens me. I want this paid today." Burak says, "Then let's find out which bill is still open."
^Ask Burak to check the paper before any payment.
^Pay the first claim from your own savings.
notebook: ^The notebook contains a neighbour's name, a hospital address, and a page about Leyla's marriage. She never told Kemal it ended. His last note says, "Visit Şükrü. Take the envelope."
^Selin comes after office hours. She is Halil's daughter. Her mother, Nuran, died recently. "I can sit with you. I don't need the whole story."
^Keep the page private. Find the account details without the room's help.
^Read the page aloud. Get help matching the dates, at a cost to privacy.
request: ^The envelope holds an old photograph of Şükrü and a letter Kemal never sent. Şükrü lives across the city. His lift is broken. You cannot leave the house and receive visitors at the same time.
^Selin has her own household to get back to. Asking her to stay means asking her family to wait. Hacer says help must have a beginning and an end.
^Burak says, "I was taught to offer condolences once. I won't keep calling you back to that conversation. I can still help with the papers."
^Ask Selin to delay going home and agree on a short shift tomorrow.
^Let Selin go home. Plan to make the journey without her help.
morning: ^The soup bowl is empty. The coat has not moved. Leyla has slept badly. Burak can return later with his papers; nobody needs her answer this minute.
^Eat and rest while the door is covered or closed.
^Stay at the door and skip the meal.

b: ^ brings the original receipt you requested. It records money returned to Burak for an earlier repair.
^ has a phone photograph of a receipt. The edge with the recipient’s name is cut off. It may concern an earlier repair.
^It does not settle the boiler bill owed to Şükrü. The original shows that Kemal joined two separate entries on one line.
^The photograph does not show who received the money. Şükrü says he has not been paid for the boiler.

receipt: ^Burak says, "I was wrong to call it one account. We need the original receipt and Şükrü to confirm what remains."
^Compare the receipt with both entries in private.
^Ask Burak to check the original by phone. Sit down while he calls.

b: ^Someone has agreed to cover the door for a short shift.
^Nobody has agreed to cover the door. A visit still needs a named person and a time.

visit: ^Şükrü answers the phone. "I wanted the photograph. He kept saying he would come." The letter offers no explanation for the years he did not.
^Ask for a named visit and get Şükrü's agreement.
^Arrange a later delivery with Şükrü. Give up seeing him on this trip.
whisper: ^Hacer hears that there is a hospital name in the notebook. "Is that why he needed money?" she asks. The person named there has not agreed to tell anyone.
^The account can be checked without telling that story. Keeping the notebook means handling the questions yourself. Lending it means trusting Burak with the original.
^Keep the notebook. Answer questions without sharing the hospital name.
^Lend Burak the closed notebook. Let him handle the bill in private.
third: ^The house is quieter. This is the last day of Leyla's leave. It is not the last day she will miss her father.
^Şükrü says the boiler bill is still open. Burak will write the two repairs on separate lines and send the corrected bill to the person handling Kemal's papers.
^ Leyla can ask him to do that; she does not have to pay to end the conversation.
^Record Şükrü's claim and Burak's agreed next step.
^Pay Şükrü yourself if the receipt confirms his bill.

b: ^Şükrü has agreed to receive the photograph and letter. He needs to know who is coming.
^Şükrü still has no answer about the envelope.
^The account now has separate entries and a named person following it.
^The two entries are still being treated as one.

answer: ^Make the journey yourself, if there is time.
^Pay for delivery. Ask Burak to take it on the agreed date.
witness: ^On the last evening, Selin stops by after work to say goodbye. She sets down her bag. "You don't have to tell me why your marriage ended."
^"After my mother died, people talked about limits on mourning," Selin says. "I don't take that to mean I must stop missing her. I won't ask that of you."
^Leyla can tell her one thing that belongs to Leyla: she wanted to tell Kemal, and now she cannot. Speaking keeps Selin here longer. Silence lets her leave, but Leyla keeps the words to herself.
^Tell Selin what you wished you could say.
^Keep this to yourself and let Selin go home.
evening: ^The room needs no final speech. Hacer takes her saucepan. Burak leaves a number where Leyla can reach him. The envelope must leave with Leyla if its visit is still unanswered.
^Close the door and take the next steps with you.
ending: ^The leave ends. The grief continues. Kemal's silence has not become an explanation. Leyla can carry unanswered questions without pretending they are answered.
